resources.string: ShayLock uses this service to detect when one of your protected apps is opened so it can display a full-screen lock screen over it. It only watches which app is in the foreground and blocks the Home, Back and Recents buttons while the lock screen is shown.
Shows an ongoing notification while app blocking is active.
Your protected apps are being watched. Tap to open the dashboard.
Warns you when ShayLock protection has been switched off.
ShayLock\'s accessibility service is disabled, so your protected apps are no longer being blocked. Tap to re-enable it.
